name: Protagonist
source:
A very famous and respected doctor in the village. Through fate he obtains a slave, he decides to take care of her and show her some compassion. With the passage of time he falls in love with Sylvie (his slave) whom he decides to take as his "lover".

*Note: some names may change the dialogs between the protagonist and Sylvie
